content:
“Channel the spirit of the Old West!”— Perk card description

**Gunslinger** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

+12% weak spot damage to ranged weapons.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your ranged weapons do +12% weak spot damage. | 0031AEFC | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your ranged weapons do +9% weak spot damage. | 0031AEFB | 
| ★ | 1 | Your ranged weapons do +6% weak spot damage. | 0031AEFA | 

- Before Update 58 Gunslinger provided 10%/15%/20% more damage to non-automatic pistols per rank.
